name: Haebaru (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Haebaru town emblem in white: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Haebaru, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 April 1971.

features.role: Haebaru town emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring with a small disc
